phrases.text: Question 1 is about the Senate's time to act on judicial appointments.
Today, a judicial appointment is approved unless the Senate rejects it within thirty days.
The Legislature is part-time, so the Senate may need a special session.
The amendment would allow sixty days for appointments made between April 1 and December 31.
The 2026 Voter Guide does not include a cost estimate for the amendment.
Hawaii's voter guide includes no official argument against the amendment.
Hawaii's voter guide includes no official argument for the amendment.
A yes vote allows sixty days for appointments made from April through December.
A no vote keeps thirty days and leaves the constitution unchanged.
To pass, yes votes need a majority of yes and no votes, and at least half of all votes cast, including blank votes and overvotes.
